title: Sindh Prohibition of Taking Minerals Including Reti Sand and Bajri from any Land Ordinance 2003

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Prohibition of Taking Minerals Including Reti Sand and Bajri from any Land Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE I OF 2003
ORDINANCE I OF
2003
SINDH (PROHIBITION
OF TAKING MINERALS INCLUDING RETI (SAND AND BAJRI FROM ANY LAND) ORDINANCE,
2003
An Ordinance to
provide for the prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand) and bajri
from any land by excavation or otherwise, in the Province of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 10th May, 2003]
No.S.Legis.1(O1)/2003/1, dated
10-5-2003.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Sindh (Prohibition of taking Minerals
including Reti. (Sand and Bajri from any Land) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Definitions.--In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context--
(a)
"Government" means the Government of Sindh;
(b)
"land" includes the land beneath water and subsoil of land; and
(c)
"rules" means rules made under this Ordinance.

An Ordinance to

3. Restriction on taking
minerals including reti (sand) and bajri.--Except with the prior sanction
of Government or any authority or officer authorized in this respect, no person
shall take minerals including reti (sand) and bajri from any land by excavation
or otherwise.
